title: 界面信息不清晰或缺失
description: 游戏界面未能清晰传达关键信息，如状态、机制、物品属性等，导致玩家难以理解游戏状态或做出正确决策。
evidence: Moodlets and social combat? Never clear what to do and why my chars' mood is so poor.
I can't grasp when I can fix something, or if it is attached.
Same when you are repairing or restoring things. There is no info about what skills or traits actually affect any part of what you can do.

evidence_items.quote: The building app desperately needs parts grouped by family instead of one long list.
evidence_items.description: 建造应用零件未按类别分组，列表过长
evidence_items.quote_zh: 建造应用迫切需要按系列对部件进行分组，而不是一个长长的列表。

evidence_items.quote: A ship cargo manifest is a must. I cannot remember whether I have 110 or 210 floor pieces when collecting for a retrofit.
evidence_items.description: 缺少货舱清单，无法确认零件数量
evidence_items.quote_zh: 飞船货物清单是必须的。在为改装收集材料时，我记不清自己是有110块还是210块地板件。

evidence_items.quote: I can't grasp when I can fix something, or if it is attached.
evidence_items.description: 无法判断物品是否可以修复或是否已连接。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我搞不懂什么时候能修东西，或者它是不是连着的。

evidence_items.quote: Make it obvious which PDA is yours in the files menu
evidence_items.description: 文件菜单中难以分辨哪个PDA是自己的
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在文件菜单中明确显示哪个PDA是你的

evidence_items.quote: Why are some items "pristine" and others not?  It obviously isn't item durability, as I have seen pristine items that have been torn apart down to 30% or less. Repairing it to full, 100% doesn't make it either. No rhyme or reason.
evidence_items.description: 物品的“pristine”状态含义不明，与耐久度无关
evidence_items.quote_zh: 为什么有些物品是“完好”的而另一些不是？这显然不是物品耐久度，因为我见过被拆到30%或更低的完好物品。把它修到100%满耐久也不行。毫无规律可言。

evidence_items.quote: there is nothing telling me why that is. If not for the wiki, I would have no clue what "security threshold" even means.
evidence_items.description: 属性、特质和技能的作用缺乏说明
evidence_items.quote_zh: 没有任何东西告诉我为什么会这样。要不是有wiki，我根本不知道“安全阈值”是什么意思。

evidence_items.quote: the hard-to-use build menu
evidence_items.description: 建造菜单难以使用
evidence_items.quote_zh: 难用的建造菜单

evidence_items.quote: Also the sprites used are pretty hard to identify visually at first, couldn't really tell what most things were at first glance without right clicking it or holding alt.
evidence_items.description: 精灵图难以辨认，需要右键或按Alt才能识别
evidence_items.quote_zh: 另外，所用的精灵图一开始在视觉上很难辨认，不右键点击或按住Alt的话，我第一眼真的看不出大多数东西是什么。

evidence_items.quote: if you become wanted, the game doesn't show you why
evidence_items.description: 成为通缉犯时，游戏不显示原因。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果你被通缉了，游戏不会告诉你原因

evidence_items.quote: the tutorial should be a few hours long, like a campaign that guides you through every mechanics this game has to offer. Not just a basics of scavening
evidence_items.description: 教程没有涵盖所有机制
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在我看来，教程应该有几个小时长，就像一个战役，引导你了解这款游戏提供的每一个机制。而不仅仅是打捞的基础知识

evidence_items.quote: 每一项动作都要在三级以上的菜单里，排的密密麻麻的选项中点来点去
evidence_items.description: 日常动作需在三级以上菜单中反复点击，操作繁琐
evidence_items.quote_zh: 每一项动作都要在三级以上的菜单里，排的密密麻麻的选项中点来点去

evidence_items.quote: 游戏各种属性好像也是太过个人设计化了，标签属性有些不知道是什么作用，而且那么多属性，你说多吧，还不够实际上那么全面，你说少吧，一大堆，也没个说明是有啥作用
evidence_items.description: 属性系统过于个人设计化，标签属性作用不明，缺乏说明
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏各种属性好像也是太过个人设计化了，标签属性有些不知道是什么作用，而且那么多属性，你说多吧，还不够实际上那么全面，你说少吧，一大堆，也没个说明是有啥作用

evidence_items.quote: almost complete lack of feedback when for example my little dude is dying due to a heatstroke
evidence_items.description: 角色因中暑死亡时几乎没有反馈
evidence_items.quote_zh: 几乎没有反馈，比如我的小家伙因为中暑快要死了

evidence_items.quote: Очень часто приходится догадываться, что делает та или иная кнопка.
evidence_items.description: 界面按钮功能不明确，需要猜测
evidence_items.quote_zh: 经常不得不去猜某个按钮到底是干什么的。

evidence_items.quote: when you're in a helmet, it blocks your UI. Because of this, I missed a very important button for 30 hours
evidence_items.description: 头盔遮挡UI，导致长时间错过重要按钮
evidence_items.quote_zh: 当你戴着头盔时，它会挡住你的UI。因为这个，我错过了30个小时里一个非常重要的按钮

evidence_items.quote: When you dock, "Match speed" and "Prox Warn" alarms are not in the dock screen, AND YOU REALLY NEED THEM IN THE DOCK SCREEN
evidence_items.description: 停靠界面缺少匹配速度和接近警告警报
evidence_items.quote_zh: 当你停靠时，“匹配速度”和“接近警告”警报不在停靠界面里，而你停靠时真的非常需要它们

evidence_items.quote: which part is draining power, how can I manage that? i cannot know
evidence_items.description: 无法查看哪个部件在耗电，只能手动关闭设备
evidence_items.quote_zh: 哪个部件在耗电，我该如何管理？我根本无从得知

evidence_items.quote: The wiki doesn't have the mass. The editor doesn't show the mass. Heck, right clicking a piece in an active game doesn't show the mass. Only picking up an uninstalled piece in game shows you the mass.
evidence_items.description: 编辑器、wiki和游戏中右键都不显示部件质量，只有拾取未安装部件时才显示
evidence_items.quote_zh: wiki上没有质量数据。编辑器不显示质量。见鬼，在正在进行的游戏里右键点击一个部件也不显示质量。只有在游戏里捡起一个未安装的部件才会显示质量。

evidence_items.quote: how do you make a ship editor that doesn't give you the ship diagnostics of the ship you're building?
evidence_items.description: 飞船编辑器不显示正在建造飞船的质量、推进器需求等诊断信息
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你怎么能做一个不给你显示你正在建造的飞船的飞船诊断信息的飞船编辑器呢？

evidence_items.quote: Stats of ship components are not visible anywhere.
evidence_items.description: 飞船组件属性在游戏中不可见
evidence_items.quote_zh: 飞船组件的属性在任何地方都看不到。

evidence_items.quote: 그 미세 운석이라는걸 게임에서는 언급도 하지 않으며 가르쳐주지도 않으며 이로 인한 손상이 생겨도 관련된 아무런 언급도 없다
evidence_items.description: 船体突然破损但游戏未提示微陨石等可能原因
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏里对所谓的微陨石既不提及也不教，而且因此产生损伤时也没有任何相关说明

evidence_items.quote:
エアポンプと酸素缶を設置してオートにしたら良い感じに動いてくれるだろう
→動いてくれない？？？何故？？？
→オート設定時にUIのネジをクリックしてパネル外して出て来るUIでセンサーと接続しないとオート稼働しない
evidence_items.description: 空调UI说明不足，自动模式需要连接传感器但未提示
evidence_items.quote_zh:
装上气泵和氧气罐然后设为自动，应该就能很好地运转吧
→不运转？？？为什么？？？
→在自动设置时点击UI上的螺丝，拆下面板后出现的UI里，不连接传感器就不会自动运行

evidence_items.quote: the UI, the ships and their interior layouts, and a few other things are a total disaster.
evidence_items.description: UI设计糟糕
evidence_items.quote_zh: 用户界面、飞船及其内部布局，还有其他一些东西，完全是一场灾难。

evidence_items.quote: the combat UI is horrible with a barebones combat log with no proper feedback to what is actually happening
evidence_items.description: 战斗UI糟糕，战斗日志简陋且缺乏反馈
evidence_items.quote_zh: 战斗UI很糟糕，只有一个简陋的战斗日志，对实际发生的事情没有适当的反馈

evidence_items.quote: Can't tell what's a bug and what's not, which is the worst kind of game. This game is not difficult, the only thing that makes it "hardcore" is complete lack of transparency and dumb design decisions.
evidence_items.description: 游戏缺乏透明度，玩家无法分辨bug和正常机制
evidence_items.quote_zh: 分不清什么是bug什么不是，这是最糟糕的一类游戏。这游戏并不难，唯一让它显得“硬核”的就是完全不透明和愚蠢的设计决策。

evidence_items.quote: the values you're provided are super wonky and there's very little in the way of orbital info provided to you
evidence_items.description: 对接时提供的轨道信息不足，数值异常
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你获得的数据超级不靠谱，而且提供给你的轨道信息少得可怜

evidence_items.quote: UI Scaling
evidence_items.description: UI缩放存在问题
evidence_items.quote_zh: UI缩放

evidence_items.quote: Ship status is just text report
evidence_items.description: 飞船状态只是文字报告
evidence_items.quote_zh: 飞船状态只是文字报告

evidence_items.quote: most of the text being unreadable
evidence_items.description: 大部分文本难以阅读
evidence_items.quote_zh: 大部分文本都无法阅读

evidence_items.quote: I often struggled to remember where and how I can find general information about what is happening right now or getting a good overview of all my ressources.
evidence_items.description: 难以找到当前状态信息，也难以总览所有资源
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我常常很难记住在哪里以及如何找到关于当前正在发生什么的通用信息，或者如何很好地总览我的所有资源。

evidence_items.quote: the game only tells you how far away the target is, not its exact location
evidence_items.description: 导航系统只显示距离，不显示目标具体位置，导致难以找到目标
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏只告诉你目标有多远，而不是它的确切位置

evidence_items.quote: Tutorial is awful. Everything is so cluttered and all over the place.
evidence_items.description: 教程界面杂乱无章，信息混乱
evidence_items.quote_zh: 教程糟透了。一切都杂乱无章、乱七八糟。

evidence_items.quote: Moodlets and social combat? Never clear what to do and why my chars' mood is so poor.
evidence_items.description: 情绪与社交战斗机制不清晰，角色情绪差的原因不明
evidence_items.quote_zh: 心情值和社交战斗？从来都搞不清该做什么，也搞不清为什么我角色的心情这么差。

evidence_items.quote: Error messages for when you lack things to complete work (like repair a wall or item) could definitely be more verbose for what you need, or what's wrong.
evidence_items.description: 缺少物品时错误提示不够详细，未说明具体需要什么
evidence_items.quote_zh: 当你缺少完成工作所需的东西时（比如修理墙壁或物品）的错误提示，绝对可以更详细地说明你需要什么，或者哪里出了问题。

evidence_items.quote: needs QOL updates
evidence_items.description: 需要生活质量更新
evidence_items.quote_zh: 需要生活质量更新

evidence_items.quote: If you do not like to spend time understanding game mechanics that are, at times, not explained very well, you will probably not enjoy Ostranauts.
evidence_items.description: 游戏机制有时解释不清
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果你不喜欢花时间去理解那些有时解释得并不清楚的游戏机制，你大概不会喜欢《Ostranauts》。

evidence_items.quote: The UI is kinda difficult to read through at first
evidence_items.description: UI一开始难以阅读
evidence_items.quote_zh: UI 一开始读起来有点困难

evidence_items.quote: fires give no feedback at all on what actually caused the fire
evidence_items.description: 火灾不提供任何关于起火原因的反馈
evidence_items.quote_zh: 火灾完全没有提供任何关于实际起火原因的反馈

evidence_items.quote: I personally struggle to locate where people when they are not on station
evidence_items.description: 难以定位不在空间站上的人物位置
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我个人很难在人们不在空间站时找到他们的位置

evidence_items.quote: very bad ingame manuals
evidence_items.description: 游戏内手册非常糟糕
evidence_items.quote_zh: 非常糟糕的游戏内手册

evidence_items.quote: explains nothing
evidence_items.description: 游戏没有解释说明
evidence_items.quote_zh: 什么都不解释

evidence_items.quote: Control windows take up two-thirds of the screen for no clear reason
evidence_items.description: 控制窗口占据屏幕三分之二
evidence_items.quote_zh: 控制窗口占据了屏幕的三分之二，却没有任何明确的理由

evidence_items.quote: holding left alt just highlights whats usable, doesnt tell you WHAT they are so in messy maps where all textures look like a frat house its like playing a game of where's waldo to find something
evidence_items.description: 按住左Alt只高亮可用物品，不显示具体是什么，在杂乱地图中难以寻找
evidence_items.quote_zh: 按住左Alt只会高亮可用的东西，却不告诉你它们是什么，所以在所有纹理看起来都像兄弟会派对现场那样凌乱的地图里，就像在玩找沃尔多的游戏一样找东西

evidence_items.quote: Text at times is impossible to read from tutorials
evidence_items.description: 教程文本有时难以阅读
evidence_items.quote_zh: 教程里的文字有时根本无法阅读

evidence_items.quote: A change I would like would be in-game suggestions/tips that inform the player how they can change their traits.
evidence_items.description: 游戏内缺少关于如何改变角色特质的提示信息
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我希望有一项改动，就是加入游戏内建议/提示，告诉玩家如何改变他们的特质。

evidence_items.quote: at times its hard to find
evidence_items.description: 船上物品难以找到，缺少搜索功能
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有时很难找到

evidence_items.quote: The character needs menu does not work as intended, it might be 10% full but the tooltip says that the character is very tired
evidence_items.description: 角色需求菜单显示不准确，10%满却提示非常疲惫
evidence_items.quote_zh: 角色的需求菜单没有按预期工作，它可能只满了10%，但提示框却说角色非常疲惫

evidence_items.quote: amazingly awkward UI
evidence_items.description: UI非常别扭
evidence_items.quote_zh: 极其别扭的界面

evidence_items.quote: you get no information on the price of a new employee until after you hire them
evidence_items.description: 雇佣新员工前无法获知其价格信息
evidence_items.quote_zh: 据我所知，在你雇用新员工之前，你无法获得关于他们价格的信息

evidence_items.quote: Where you can/should sell each item is really unclear so you wind up walking around a lot to find someone to buy things.
evidence_items.description: 不清楚在哪里出售物品，导致玩家需要四处寻找买家。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你可以在哪里/应该在哪里出售每件物品真的很不清楚，所以你最终会走来走去，到处找人买东西。

evidence_items.quote: I don't get any warnings when my ship battery is running low, or if I'm running low on O2 or N2
evidence_items.description: 电池、氧气等资源不足时没有警告提示
evidence_items.quote_zh: 当我的飞船电池电量低时，或者当我O2或N2不足时，我得不到任何警告

evidence_items.quote: How to hook up sensors and panels (I had gotten it but there really isn't any major UI indication)
evidence_items.description: 连接传感器和面板时缺乏明显的UI指示
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如何连接传感器和面板（我搞明白了，但真的没有任何明显的UI提示）

evidence_items.quote: is there some kind of UI that gives you a status on these things in one place? Na.
evidence_items.description: 缺少集中显示空气、燃料、电力等状态的界面
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有没有某种UI能在一个地方给你显示这些东西的状态？没。

evidence_items.quote: adding regular tool-tips that clarify points of common confusion
evidence_items.description: 缺少常规提示，常见困惑点没有说明
evidence_items.quote_zh: 添加常规的工具提示，以澄清常见的困惑点

evidence_items.quote: It would be nice to know which backpack has what slots when you have 3 on
evidence_items.description: 多个库存界面打开时，难以区分哪个背包有哪些槽位
evidence_items.quote_zh: 当你背着3个背包时，能知道哪个背包有哪些槽位就好了

evidence_items.quote: I have a hard time seeing the separation of spaces (i.e. ship, docking port, station, etc).  Unless I hover my mouse over everything and get the tooltip, I have a hard time understanding if I'm on my ship or a ship/station I've docked at, etc
evidence_items.description: 难以区分不同空间（如飞船、对接端口、空间站），除非悬停鼠标查看提示。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我很难看出各个空间的分隔（即飞船、对接端口、空间站等）。除非我把鼠标悬停到所有东西上并调出提示框，否则我很难理解自己是在自己的飞船上，还是在我已对接的飞船/空间站上，等等

evidence_items.quote: the ui placements sucks it constantly overlays with important data i want to acces
evidence_items.description: UI位置糟糕，经常覆盖重要数据
evidence_items.quote_zh: UI的布局很糟糕，它总是覆盖在我想要访问的重要数据上

evidence_items.quote: it was such a tiny bit of text i got notified with (bad thing could have used a bigger headsup)
evidence_items.description: 通知文字太小，容易错过
evidence_items.quote_zh: 那只是一丁点文字，我就这样收到了通知（糟糕的地方，本可以用更明显的提示）

evidence_items.quote: Alarms go off, no blinkers anywhere, without explanation
evidence_items.description: 警报响起但无任何指示或解释。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 警报响起，哪里都没有指示灯，没有任何解释

evidence_items.quote: nothing is conveyed to the player at all
evidence_items.description: 游戏未向玩家传达任何信息。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 完全没有向玩家传达任何信息

evidence_items.quote: the game uses a task system that is not shown to the player so your character will randomly just start wandering off to do things
evidence_items.description: 任务系统未在屏幕上显示，导致角色随机行动。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏使用了一个不向玩家展示的任务系统，所以你的角色会随机自己跑去做事情

evidence_items.quote: can you have the cop and or the judge tell me what, when, I broke the
evidence_items.description: 游戏未告知玩家犯了什么罪、何时犯的罪。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 能不能让警察和/或法官告诉我，我是什么时候、犯了什么法

evidence_items.quote: information that's hard to find (How ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ often is long term docking fees charged? whats the point of PDAs, etc)
evidence_items.description: 游戏信息难以查找，例如长期停靠费收取频率和PDA用途不明确
evidence_items.quote_zh: 很难找到的信息（长期停靠费到底♥♥♥♥♥♥♥多久收一次？PDA到底有什么用，等等）

evidence_items.quote: A INTERFACE SIMPLEMENTE NAO TE DIZ NADA
evidence_items.description: 界面不告诉玩家发生了什么，玩家不知道角色是否在死亡
evidence_items.quote_zh: 界面根本就不告诉你任何东西

evidence_items.quote: Very[/i] unfriendly tutorial. I was excited my the idea of this game but there's so much visual noise immediately.
evidence_items.description: 教程不友好，视觉信息杂乱，新玩家难以理解
evidence_items.quote_zh: [i]非常[/i]不友好的教程。我本来对这个游戏的想法很兴奋，但立刻就有太多视觉噪音。

evidence_items.quote: It's also really not apparent which is your ship to a new player, in relation to anything.
evidence_items.description: 新玩家难以辨认自己的飞船
evidence_items.quote_zh: 对于新玩家来说，也完全看不出哪艘是你的船，与任何东西的关系都看不出来。

evidence_items.quote: The top-view makes it hard to identify some things for new newbies though. Especially when it is cluttered
evidence_items.description: 俯视图导致新玩家难以识别物体，尤其在杂乱时
evidence_items.quote_zh: 不过，俯视视角让一些新新手很难辨认某些东西。尤其是在杂乱的时候

evidence_items.quote: it tried to send me to a place I couldn't find on the map and had no idea how to locate
evidence_items.description: 任务地点在地图上找不到
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它试图把我送到一个我在地图上找不到、也完全不知道如何定位的地方

evidence_items.quote: The UI is a bit off putting
evidence_items.description: 界面令人不适
evidence_items.quote_zh: 用户界面有点让人望而却步

evidence_items.quote: Even just trying to look around and SEE whats in a ship is painful. Is that tiny sprite storage? Is it worth anything? Did you just target a person? Here's 100 status effects they have good luck parsing out useful information in this cluttered hell.
evidence_items.description: 查看飞船内物品困难，难以分辨小图标和状态效果
evidence_items.quote_zh: 哪怕只是想环顾四周、看看飞船里有什么都很痛苦。那个小小的像素点是储物箱吗？它值钱吗？你刚才是不是选中了一个人？这里有100个状态效果，祝你好运在这个杂乱的地狱里解析出有用的信息。

evidence_items.quote: social interaction and character moodlets offering little to no information about what they actually do either
evidence_items.description: 社交互动和角色情绪状态几乎不提供任何说明信息
evidence_items.quote_zh: 社交互动和角色心情状态也几乎不提供任何信息，说明它们到底有什么作用

evidence_items.quote: game or manual doesn't mention anything
evidence_items.description: 手册未说明非法打捞会被罚款，玩家不知情
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏或手册都没有提到任何相关内容

evidence_items.quote: 'Continue' on titlescreen is often for continuing a last save, should probably be called 'load'
evidence_items.description: 标题界面的'Continue'按钮实际是加载存档，应叫'load'
evidence_items.quote_zh: 标题画面上的“继续”通常是用来继续上一次存档的，或许应该叫“加载”

evidence_items.quote: Unclear to the players when stuff needs to be paid.
evidence_items.description: 玩家不清楚何时需要付费
evidence_items.quote_zh: 玩家不清楚什么时候需要付钱。

evidence_items.quote: Not enough information to know what is going on most of the time
evidence_items.description: 大部分时间缺乏足够信息了解情况
evidence_items.quote_zh: 大多数时候信息不足，根本不知道发生了什么

evidence_items.quote: no status indicators to help see who is winning or make strategic decisions.
evidence_items.description: 战斗界面缺乏状态指示器
evidence_items.quote_zh: 没有状态指示器来帮助看清谁占上风或做出战略决策。

evidence_items.quote: 今後のアップデートでバグやクエスト関連やUIなどの改善を切望しています
evidence_items.description: 希望未来更新改善UI
evidence_items.quote_zh: 恳切希望在今后的更新中改善bug、任务相关以及UI等方面。

evidence_items.quote: unintutive at times
evidence_items.description: 游戏有时不直观
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有时不太直观

evidence_items.quote: The Game's UI has a problem communicating relevant information to the player
evidence_items.description: UI无法清晰传达相关信息，如状态效果和通缉状态
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏的UI在向玩家传达相关信息方面存在问题

evidence_items.quote: some things that should be clear in the game aren't yet
evidence_items.description: 游戏内一些本应清晰的信息尚不明确
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有些在游戏里本该说清楚的事情目前还没说清楚

evidence_items.quote: Tooltips are nowhere to be found.
evidence_items.description: 界面没有工具提示，玩家难以理解功能
evidence_items.quote_zh: 工具提示根本找不到。

evidence_items.quote: cluttered ui
evidence_items.description: UI 杂乱
evidence_items.quote_zh: 杂乱的界面

evidence_items.quote: Same when you are repairing or restoring things. There is no info about what skills or traits actually affect any part of what you can do.
evidence_items.description: 修理或恢复时没有信息说明
evidence_items.quote_zh: 修理或修复东西时也一样。没有任何信息说明哪些技能或特质实际影响你能做的任何部分。

evidence_items.quote: all of the characters I made had like 30 different tags so it was confusing
evidence_items.description: 角色标签过多导致混乱
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我创建的所有角色都有大约30个不同的标签，所以很让人困惑

evidence_items.quote: I tried building a bed, it just wouldn't, there is no info on why i could not, it doesn't show material i would need to do the build
evidence_items.description: 建造失败时没有原因说明或所需材料提示
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我试着造一张床，就是造不了，没有任何信息说明为什么造不了，也不显示建造所需的材料

evidence_items.quote: you need some kind of tutorial
evidence_items.description: 游戏需要教程但缺失
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你需要某种教程

evidence_items.quote: the floor is considered a 'container'
evidence_items.description: 地板被当作容器，令人难以理解
evidence_items.quote_zh: 地板被认为是一个“容器”

evidence_items.quote: it's hard to distinguish the tutorial popups from the container popups
evidence_items.description: 教程弹窗与容器弹窗难以区分，界面非标准导致困惑
evidence_items.quote_zh: 很难区分教程弹窗和容器弹窗

evidence_items.quote: It gives you no information what the F is happening in your environment
evidence_items.description: 游戏不提供环境信息
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它不给你任何信息，让你不知道你的环境里到底发生了什么鬼事

evidence_items.quote: dificil la interfaz
evidence_items.description: 界面难以使用
evidence_items.quote_zh: 界面很难用

evidence_items.quote: when you save your game, you have no idea at what point its saved. So you can loose 10 mins of game play when you reload the game.
evidence_items.description: 保存游戏时不清楚保存点，重新加载可能丢失进度。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 当你保存游戏时，你根本不知道它是在哪个时间点保存的。所以当你重新加载游戏时，可能会损失10分钟的游戏进度。

evidence_items.quote: I would appreciate it if there were less dialogue options or at least more distinct options outside trying to fill your meters up
evidence_items.description: 对话选项过多且缺乏区分度
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果对话选项能少一些，或者至少除了试图填满你的各项数值之外能有更多不同的选项，我会很感激

evidence_items.quote: It would help the player to know how long an action would take and how much oxygen time the ship/suit has
evidence_items.description: 缺乏行动耗时和氧气剩余时间的提示
evidence_items.quote_zh: 让玩家知道一个动作需要多长时间以及飞船/宇航服还有多少氧气时间会很有帮助

evidence_items.quote: It can be hard to figure out what your supposed to be doing or how to do it
evidence_items.description: 难以理解游戏目标和操作方法
evidence_items.quote_zh: 很难弄清楚你应该做什么或者怎么做

evidence_items.quote: Character attributes/feeling/environment could do with a mouse over help option
evidence_items.description: 角色属性/感觉/环境缺少鼠标悬停帮助
evidence_items.quote_zh: 角色属性/感受/环境如果能有一个鼠标悬停帮助选项就好了

evidence_items.quote: there honestly should be a damage hud to show you whats damage what has O2 what is getting O2 and where power connectors are not were they are powering
evidence_items.description: 缺少伤害HUD，无法显示损坏、氧气和电力连接信息
evidence_items.quote_zh: 老实说，应该有一个伤害HUD来显示什么受损、什么有O2、什么正在获得O2，以及电源连接器不在它们供电的位置。

evidence_items.quote: While I feel the UI could use some work to make things clearer, all the information needed is there, if only in a tiny font most of the time.
evidence_items.description: UI不够清晰，字体太小
evidence_items.quote_zh: 虽然我觉得UI可以做一些改进，让内容更清晰，但所有需要的信息都在那里，只不过大多数时候字体很小。

evidence_items.quote: Does your character have Hypoxia, who can tell, still making the same face when pressure and O2 is normal
evidence_items.description: 角色状态缺乏反馈，缺氧时表情不变
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你的角色是否缺氧，谁能看得出来，当气压和氧气正常时还是同样的表情

evidence_items.quote: this game really urgent needs more feedback for the player and a better / clear interface
evidence_items.description: 急需更好的玩家反馈和更清晰的界面
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这款游戏真的迫切需要给玩家更多反馈以及一个更好/更清晰的界面

evidence_items.quote: pieces of the ship that are not repaired yet with no indication
evidence_items.description: 未修复的船体部分没有指示
evidence_items.quote_zh: 船上尚未修复的部分没有任何提示

evidence_items.quote: Ещё одной серьёзной проблемой является полное отсутствие пояснений к интерфейсу. Отсутствуют контекстные подсказки при наведении курсора.
evidence_items.description: 界面完全缺少说明，悬停时没有上下文提示，角色菜单中的状态无法理解其含义和影响
evidence_items.quote_zh: 另一个严重问题是完全没有对界面的说明。鼠标悬停时没有上下文提示。

evidence_items.quote: Honestly harder UI to play with than Dwarf Fortress.
evidence_items.description: UI比Dwarf Fortress还难操作
evidence_items.quote_zh: 老实说，UI比《矮人要塞》还难操作。

evidence_items.quote: multiple instances just in the character creation where text is overlaping on top of each other.
evidence_items.description: 角色创建界面文字重叠
evidence_items.quote_zh: 仅仅在角色创建中就有多处文字相互重叠。

evidence_items.quote: it just tells me to check my inventory, which i did and the task still doesn't go away
evidence_items.description: 检查库存后任务仍未消失
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它只是叫我去检查我的物品栏，我检查了，但任务还是没有消失
